# Users

The **Users** page lists everyone who can sign in to the Acme dashboard. You find it in the sidebar under **Team**.

## Add a new user

1. Go to **Team** > **Users**.
2. Click **Invite user**.
3. Enter their email address and pick a role.
4. Click **Send invite**. The invite link expires after 7 days.

## Roles

![[Roles]]

## Remove a user

Open the user, then click **Remove access**. Their past orders stay in the system.
